nodes.norm_label: exceptionmiddleware (global exception to status code mapping)
nodes.rationale: Handlers should throw typed exceptions instead of System.Exception (which yields 500); middleware maps NotFound->404, BusinessRule->422, concurrency->409 as ProblemDetails.

nodes.label: Pagination, Filtering, Sorting

nodes.label: Attribute Routing and Route Constraints
nodes.rationale: A failed constraint means the route does not match, so the client gets 404 rather than 400.

nodes.label: PATCH-5 Concurrent Stock Adjustment
nodes.rationale: Read-check-write must be atomic (lock, or a single conditional UPDATE via EF Core ExecuteUpdateAsync) so stock never goes negative under parallel checkouts.

nodes.label: ActionResult<T> vs IActionResult vs concrete type
nodes.norm_label: actionresult<t> vs iactionresult vs concrete type
nodes.rationale: ActionResult<T> is recommended: returns T for 200 or any error result, and Swagger can infer the schema; concrete types cannot express 404.

nodes.label: MediatR Publish vs Send (IRequest<T>)
nodes.rationale: Publish goes to 0..N handlers with no return (domain events); Send goes to exactly one handler and returns T, so a create command should use Send to get the id for a 201.

nodes.label: CQRS (reads via query services, writes via MediatR notifications)
nodes.norm_label: cqrs (reads via query services, writes via mediatr notifications)
nodes.rationale: Each service separates reads (controller calls query service directly, EF Core + paging + DTO mapping) from writes (controller publishes MediatR notification, handler applies change and saves).
